_comment: Preguntas ORIGINALES tipo NIE del capítulo 2.4. No son preguntas reales del examen. Comprueba con tu edición 2027.

questions.scenario: Under s. 1 TA 2000, the use or threat of action must be made for the purpose of advancing a…
options: Political, religious, racial or ideological cause

questions.scenario: When is the 'designed to influence the government or intimidate the public' element NOT required?
options: When the action involves the use of firearms or explosives

questions.scenario: Which of these can be 'action' under s. 1?
options: Action designed seriously to interfere with or disrupt an electronic system

questions.scenario: What is the maximum penalty for belonging to a proscribed organisation (s. 11)?
D wears a T-shirt with the logo of a proscribed group in a shopping centre, arousing reasonable suspicion he supports it. Which offence?
options: s. 13 – uniform/articles arousing reasonable suspicion of membership or support

questions.scenario: Since 2019, s. 12 also covers expressing an opinion supportive of a proscribed organisation while being…
options: Reckless whether a person will be encouraged to support it

questions.scenario: A bank employee suspects a customer's transfers are funding terrorism. Which duty applies?
options: s. 19 – duty to disclose suspicion of terrorist property offences from information obtained in employment

questions.scenario: D knows his brother is planning an attack next week and tells nobody. Which offence?
options: s. 38B – failure to disclose information about acts of terrorism

questions.scenario: D repeatedly views a bomb-making guide online with no reasonable excuse. Which offence?
options: s. 58 – collection of information, which includes viewing via the internet

questions.scenario: Which offence carries life: any conduct in preparation for giving effect to an intention to commit acts of terrorism?
Under s. 41 TA 2000, a constable may arrest without warrant a person he…
options: Reasonably suspects to be a terrorist

questions.scenario: What is the maximum period of pre-charge detention under s. 41 with warrants of further detention (⚠)?
Who can authorise a s. 47A (no suspicion) stop and search?
options: An officer of at least assistant chief constable rank

questions.scenario: What is the maximum duration of a s. 47A authorisation?
Within what time must the Secretary of State confirm a s. 47A authorisation?
Under s. 43, what is needed to stop and search a person?
options: Reasonable suspicion that the person is a terrorist

questions.scenario: Schedule 7 TA 2000 allows examination at ports…
options: Without any suspicion, to determine whether a person appears concerned in terrorism

questions.scenario: What does the Prevent duty require of specified authorities?
options: Due regard to the need to prevent people from being drawn into terrorism

questions.scenario: What are the 4 Ps of CONTEST?
What is the public advice in the event of a firearms/weapons attack?
